subject: Renewal & Expansion - Pricing step-ups / blended rates (post-call)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-04-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps - Renewal/Expansion pricing follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Lisa - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and ask so we can lock down a recommended renewal+expansion pricing plan:

1) Current usage profile (what you confirmed on the call):
- Gen tokens: ~12M tokens/month (prompt+completion)
- Embeddings: ~1.2M vectors/month (embedding calls billed per 1k vectors)
- Peak sequence lengths: mostly <= 1k tokens, occasional 4-5k sequences (~5% of calls)

2) Expansion plan you outlined:
- Phase 1 (Q3): move 2 new product routes into prod (batch inference + streaming chat), add the clinical summarization model for 3 internal teams - estimate +40% token volume
- Phase 2 (Q4): broader rollout to clinicians, expected +100% from baseline by Jan 2027

3) Pricing info we discussed / need to confirm:
- Target blended $/1M tokens you mentioned as target range: $600- $900 per 1M tokens (given mix of generation + embeddings) - please confirm if that range is still accurate.
- Do you have a committed monthly budget range for Q3- Q4 we should map to tiered step-ups? (ballpark is fine)

4) Proposal next steps from our side:
- I'll draft a tiered renewal that includes volume step-ups (0-30M, 30-75M, 75M+) with blended rates for mixed model usage and a separate pass for embedding-heavy routes.
- If you want a single blended $/1M across all routes vs. per-route pricing, let me know - we can model both.

Deliverables & timeline:
- I'll send a pricing workbook (attachment) with 3 scenarios by EOD Tuesday 4/14.
- If those look good we'll prepare a renewal quote and DocuSign for signatures the week of 4/20.

Attachments: Acme_Estimate_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet) - will include the scenarios.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0199

On Mon Apr 12, 2026 at 11:00 AM Sanjay brought up procurement timing for signature and asked about blended vs per-route rates.

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps - Renewal/Expansion pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from my side:

1) Target price: yes, $600- $900 / 1M tokens is the ballpark we were hoping for. For budgeting I should confirm: our finance team is most comfortable if we can get to ~$650 / 1M at scale (>=75M tokens/month).

2) Budget range: for Q3 we can commit to a $30k- $60k/month run-rate depending on model selection; Q4 could expand to $80k- $150k if we push to full rollout. These are budgetary ranges - procurement needs a clear stepped commitment to approve.

3) Embeddings: embeddings-heavy routes (vector store updates + similarity) are a different cost profile. If you can provide a blended option that treats embeddings at a separate per-1k-vector rate, that would help our forecasting.

4) Approval timeline: procurement wants a firm price table + sample invoice to sign off. If you can get the workbook to us by 4/14 EOD that would be ideal.

Also looping in Lisa who runs procurement for the product org.

- Sanjay Patel
Head of Product, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T07:38:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing workbook + recommended tiers (attached)

Hi all - attached is the workbook with three scenarios: conservative, expected, and aggressive. High level summary below:

Scenario summaries (blended $/1M tokens, generation + embeddings mix):
- Conservative (baseline + 10% expansion): blended $/1M = $1,050
- Expected (baseline + 40% expansion): blended $/1M = $775
- Aggressive (baseline + 100% expansion): blended $/1M = $640

Proposed step-ups (monthly committed tiers):
- 0-30M tokens: $1,200 / 1M
- 30-75M tokens: $800 / 1M
- 75M+ tokens: $650 / 1M

Embeddings: separate rate: $35 / 1k vectors (volume discounts at 100k+ vectors/day). We also modeled a blended option that amortizes embedding cost into the per-1M token rate - see the workbook.

Notes on blended rate assumptions:
- Blended = weighted mix using your current split (approx 85% gen tokens, 15% embedding unit equivalent).
- We included a model-mix surcharge for higher-cost routes (long sequences / 4-5k tokens) - modeled as +10% on those tokens.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-tier-sheet.pdf, Acme_Estimate_Q2.xlsx

Next steps:
- Sanjay / Lisa: please confirm which scenario you want modeled into a formal quote (conservative/expected/aggressive).
- If you prefer per-route pricing for the two new product routes vs one blended rate, say so and we'll produce both in the official quote.
- Rishi / Vivek: can you confirm approval to offer the 75M+ tier at $650 / 1M and the embedding tier at $35/1k vectors? If we need a deeper discount for a 12-18 month commit we should propose it now.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-04-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing workbook + recommended tiers (approval request)

Marissa - thanks for the workbook. Short answer: we can approve the published tiers for negotiation, with the following guidance:
- 75M+ at $650 / 1M is OK for a 12-month committed contract (must include a minimum monthly commitment clause).
- For an 18-24 month commit we can offer an additional 6% volume discount off the blended rate.
- Embedding tier at $35 / 1k vectors approved for initial offer, but we should include a cap on real-time QPS that triggers a performance review.

Please proceed to prepare the formal quote and routing to legal/procurement. If procurement requests an SOW or insert for data handling, loop in legal early.

- Rishi
